catalog.subtitle: Zitholele amamodeli ngokuwasebenzisa, hlola izidingo zawo bese ukhetha ihadiwe yakho.
catalog.preparedNote: Phequlula zonke izizinda ze-AI. Eminye imisebenzi idinga injini esazohlanganiswa.
catalog.catalogError: Ukutholwa bukhoma akutholakali. Amamodeli alayishwe ngaphambilini ahlala efinyeleleka.
catalog.tight: Inkumbulo enomkhawulo noma i-CPU ebuyela emuva
catalog.estimateNote: Izilinganiso zibandakanya izisindo, umongo kanye nendawo ebekiwe. Ukusebenza, isikhala sediski samahhala nokusekelwa kwezakhiwo kusadinga ukuhlolwa.
catalog.pythonNote: Idinga imvelo emisiwe yePython/PyTorch. Ngenisa ifolda ephelele ku-Safetensors / Transformers. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-GPU kudinga ukwakhiwa kwe-CUDA.
catalog.metadataMissing: Enye imethadatha ayikwazanga ukuqinisekiswa. Buyekeza umthombo wemodeli ngaphambi kokulanda.
catalog.acknowledge: Ngibuyekeze izilinganiso kanye nokuhlolwa okusele kokuhambisana.
catalog.advisorNote: Iziphakamiso zibalwa endaweni kusuka kumethadatha nezilinganiso zememori. Ukusebenza kusadinga ukukalwa.
catalog.reasonReady: Injini ehlanganisiwe kanye nesilinganiso senkumbulo esikhululekile.
catalog.reasonRecent: Okubuyekezwe kamuva nje ngokuya ngemethadatha yomshicileli.
catalog.reasonLanguage: Ulimi lwemodeli emenyezelwe lufana nolimi lwakho lokusebenzelana.
catalog.tipLimited: Khetha okuhlukile okulula noma umongo omfushane ukuze ushiye inkumbulo eyengeziwe itholakala.
catalog.tipRuntime: Qinisekisa i-Python/PyTorch ngaphambi kokuthembela ekusheshiseni kwe-GPU.
catalog.tipFuture: Kudingeka injini eyengeziwe ngaphambi kokuthi lo msebenzi usebenze eNovera.
catalog.advisorEmpty: Alikho iphuzu lokuqala elifanelekile elingakhethwa kumethadatha yamanje.
catalog.hardwareUnknown: Ulwazi lwezingxenyekazi zekhompuyutha alukho; izincomo zidinga idatha ye-RAM ne-GPU.
catalog.contextTip: Okuqukethwe okufushane kusebenzisa inkumbulo encane ngaphandle kokushintsha usayizi wokulanda.
catalog.nvfp4Search: Kutholwe i-Blackwell GPU enenkumbulo eyanele ebikiwe. Uncamela okuhlukile kwe-NVFP4 lapho i-architecture nenjini kuzisekela. Ukulayisha kwe-FLUX.2 Klein 4B Komdabu kuyatholakala emithonjeni yendawo; hlola i-CUDA PyTorch, ukuncika kokuzithandela, amamodeli ahambisanayo nenkumbulo yamahhala ngaphambi kokulanda. Ukutholwa kwezingxenyekazi zekhompuyutha akuqinisekisi isikhathi sokusebenza esimisiwe noma isivinini sokuqinisekisa.
catalog.nvfp4Prefer: I-NVFP4 iphakanyiselwe le GPU nomndeni we-FLUX.2 Klein 4B. Ukulayisha komdabu kudinga isakhiwo esisekelwayo se-Comfy, i-CUDA PyTorch nokuncika ongakukhetha. Khetha imodeli yesithombe, isifaki khodi se-Qwen3 kanye ne-VAE ngokuhlukene kuzilungiselelo zokuDala. Isikhathi sokusebenza, inhlanganisela ephelele nenkumbulo yamahhala kusadinga ukuqinisekiswa.
catalog.nvfp4Check: I-NVFP4 itholiwe: Amandla e-GPU, inkumbulo yamahhala, isakhiwo sesisindo noma ukusekelwa kwezakhiwo akuqinisekisiwe. Hlola injini ye-CUDA ngaphambi kokukhetha lokhu okuhlukile. Ifomethi iyodwa ayiqinisekisi ukuhambisana.
catalog.nvfp4Unsupported: I-NVFP4 yomdabu ayinconywa nge-GPU etholiwe noma i-VRAM yamahhala yamanje. Cabangela ukulinganisa kwe-GGUF okuhambisanayo noma injini ehambisanayo. Leyo ndlela ayinikezi ukusheshisa kwe-FP4 yomdabu.
catalog.quantQualityAdvice: Isiqondiso se-Novera GGUF sombhalo, isithombe nezingxenye zevidiyo: I-Q6_K noma ngaphezulu iyindawo yethu yokuqala ephakanyisiwe lapho sibeka phambili ukwethembeka; I-Q4_K_M ibhalansisa ikhwalithi nenkumbulo. Lezi izincomo, hhayi umkhawulo wokunemba jikelele. Imiphumela incike kumodeli nomsebenzi. I-NVFP4 nezinye izikimu ze-quantization zidinga ukuhambisana kwazo kanye nokuhlolwa kwekhwalithi.
